function.name: set_ac_state
function.description: Set the state of the air conditioner by adjusting the temperature, mode, fan speed, and fan position to achieve the desired comfort level. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

temperature.description: Desired temperature setting for the air conditioner in degrees Celsius.

fan_speed.description: Fan speed level from 1 to 5, where 1 is the lowest speed and 5 is the highest.

fan_position.description: Fan position level from 1 to 5, where 1 is the lowest and 5 is the highest.

function.name: get_ac_state
function.description: Fetch the current operational state of the air conditioner, including mode, temperature settings, and power status. If 'unit_id' is not provided, the default air conditioner unit will be queried. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

unit_id.description: The unique identifier of the air conditioner unit. If omitted, the system will fetch the state of the default AC unit.

include_diagnostics.description: Whether to include diagnostic information in the response.

message.content:
I’m here to help you with a wide range of tasks—whether that’s answering questions, offering advice, or assisting with everyday chores. In this particular environment I have a couple of special tools that let me interact directly with your smart home:

| Tool | What it does | How you can use it |
|------|--------------|--------------------|
| `get_ac_state` | Retrieves the current status of your air‑conditioner (mode, temperature, power, diagnostics, etc.). | Call it when you want to know what the AC is doing right now. |
| `set_ac_state` | Adjusts the AC’s settings—temperature, mode (cool/heat/dry/fan/auto), fan speed, and fan position. | Use it to change the climate in your room or house. |

If you’d like to see the current AC state, just let me know and I’ll run `get_ac_state`. If you want to change something—say, set the temperature to 22 °C in cool mode with medium fan speed—I can call `set_ac_state` for you.

Beyond that, I can also:

* Answer general knowledge questions (history, science, tech, etc.).
* Help with calculations, conversions, or data analysis.
* Assist with writing, editing, or brainstorming ideas.
* Provide guidance on troubleshooting common household issues (not limited to AC).
* Offer recommendations (books, recipes, travel, etc.).

Just tell me what you need, and I’ll do my best to help!
